d:
Presenting Baarish Aayi Hai, the Rain song of all Rain songs. Featuring the most talked about TV couple of today Karan Kundrra and Tejasswi Prakkash, the song is composed by Javed - Mohsin and sung by very soothing Shreya Ghoshal and Stebin Ben. The words are by Kunaal Vermaa.Soak in the romance of the monsoon with the rain song of the season.
Audio Credits

Music Composer: Javed - Mohsin
Singer’s : Stebin Ben & Shreya Ghoshal
